## Orientation

Single task in wave 2. Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/mypy-gate--fix-orchestra-types`

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R6: `uv run basedpyright orchestra` reports no error, so the baseline needs no entry for a file under `orchestra/`.

## Approach

Run `uv run basedpyright orchestra` (no baseline yet) and fix each of the 26 errors in 11 files with behavior-neutral changes: add or narrow annotations, add `None` guards, fix wrong types. Use an inline `# pyright: ignore[<rule>]` only when a fix would change behavior, and name the rule. Add no explanatory comments. Rerun until the command exits 0. Run the four README pytest commands to confirm no behavior change.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R6: `.basedpyright/baseline.json` has no entry for a file under `orchestra/`.

### Design / decisions (quote)

- types-checker: basedpyright standard mode, pinned in the dev group, run with uv run
- types-baseline: fix orchestra errors, commit a baseline for the rest, block on new errors
- types-scope: orchestra, dashboard, installer
